---
name: sdp-framework
description: Build and change datasets in the sdp-framework repo. Use when asked to add a dataset or a table, add rules, skip a bad file, check the plan, or deploy.
---

Find the sdp-framework Git folder in this workspace. Read its AGENTS.md
before any change. Then open the procedure AGENTS.md names for the task,
under doc/procedures/, and follow its steps.

Build from doc/templates/. Don't invent a layout. Work on a branch, and show
the plan before any deploy.
